routine.title: NexusMMOEngine Data & Memory Management Improvement Crawler
routine.description: Crawls OpenAlex, Crossref, and arXiv for academic theses and peer-reviewed research on Data-Oriented Design (DoD), SIMD vectorization, lock-free ring buffers, Morton Z-order spatial hashing, and generational slab allocators. Synthesizes direct implementation Markdown specs in patches/ and delegates implementation tasks to the Gemini agent.
